title: Ethiopia Observer
desc: The US embassy in Ethiopia says it has been encouraged by former Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo’s visit to Mekelle yesterday. In a statement, US Ambassador Ervin Massinga said Mr Obasanjo’s work under his African Union mandate was critical at a time of mounting concern over renewed fighting. Tensions between the Tigrayan authorities and Ethiopia’s federal government have remained high for months, fuelling fears that the conflict could once again erupt into war. Mr Massinga said all sides should instead focus on addressing the drought conditions affecting communities across the country, as millions of people across the region face acute hunger.…
